response.justification: Bogdan has a strong background in software development with experience in multiple languages and systems, but his primary expertise lies in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and Dlang, with limited recent focus on C++ (last substantial C++ work was ~10 years ago at National Instruments). His profile lacks demonstrated experience with industrial automation, IoT protocols (e.g., MQTT, Modbus TCP/IP), or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure) required for this role. While he has architectural and team leadership experience, the mismatch in core technical competencies raises concerns about immediate fit.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and frameworks (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Dlang)
Strong architectural and problem-solving skills with a focus on test-driven development (TDD) and clean code practices
Proven ability to lead teams, mentor peers, and contribute to open-source projects, demonstrating initiative and collaboration
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last significant C++ work was ~10 years ago; role requires 8–12 years of active C++ development)
No evident experience with industrial automation, IoT protocols (MQTT, Modbus TCP/IP), or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure/Microsoft stack)
Lacks direct exposure to Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) or IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity standards required for this role
